snippet.title: 🔥KOF: Legend | Official Launch on Nov 4!
snippet.description:
🔥KOF: Legend | Official Launch on Nov 4!
⏰Dear Managers, thank you for waiting! The official countdown to the KOF Tournament has begun — On Nov 4 (Wednesday) at 10:00 AM (UTC+8), the Open Beta for KOF: Legend will officially launch!
👉Pre-register now to lock in your Open Beta Rewards: https://kof-sea.onelink.me/bVaB/FBEN-NRUDYW
📢All-star fighters have rallied, and a brand-new KOF journey is all set! What new companions will you meet and what exciting gameplay will you experience on your journey along the path to legend? Let's take a sneak peek together~!
––—ʕ·͡ˑ·ཻʔ––—
Discord: https://discord.gg/pCXP8VZvN6
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/KOFLegendOfficial
